books.title: Healing the Five Wounds of the Heart: Free Yourself from the Bonds of the Past
books.author: Dr. Marie Mbouni
books.description: Marie names five emotional wounds most of us take on in childhood (abandonment, betrayal, separation, denial and judgment) and shows how they keep replaying in adult life. Drawing on her work as a shamanic and energy healer, she offers ways to meet present situations differently and so move towards a more whole-hearted life.
